methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: In the formal F2[GL_2(F2)] rank-one-idempotent register model at exactly t=5 fully occupied coordinate-SWAP roles, screen the strictly alternating thirteen-call candidate (isolated by research/four-swap-full-occupancy's uniform cut consequence) inside the pairwise-commuting projector subfamily, and derive the general block-equation handoff for the noncommuting remainder.
scope_change_reason: Refinement of the drawn card's first experiment (price one smallest completed instance after a named changed premise). The changed premise is the target-count boundary t=5 left open by the predecessor's cut bound; the drawn GL3/Q8-style censuses are covered by #1974/#2248/#2303 and the paired agent's fresh Q8 claim, so this object was chosen to avoid those.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the bit primitive: the bit side does not bind (complex side binds the selected kappa). The screen removes the pairwise-commuting part of the only remaining sub-direct saving (thirteen vs fifteen calls) in the coordinate-CNOT tariff, so any shared-work saving search can skip commuting tuples; no kappa or supplier claim follows.
stop_rule: Stop once the commuting-family screen is complete (minimum admissible class size and five-class partition count computed), all positive and failure controls pass, and the noncommuting remainder is recorded as a handoff; no noncommuting tuple search in this session.
